name: Default
description: State machine: every state plays an animation and lists conditions that move the controller into other states. Used when no "type" is given.

fields.description: States of this controller, keyed by name. Transitions are evaluated in order every tick.
Another animation controller of the same type to inherit from. Own values override the parent's.
Named animation shortcuts, referenced as "#name". A list picks a random entry each time.
Ticks to blend when switching animations. 0 switches instantly.

name: Triggered
description: Plays one-shot animations when a condition becomes true. Each trigger plays its animation once, then waits until its condition is false again before it can fire again. No states or transitions needed.

fields.description: Animations to play, keyed by animation ID or "#key" reference, with the condition that triggers them. Earlier entries win when several conditions are true at once.
Another animation controller of the same type to inherit from. Own values override the parent's.
Named animation shortcuts, referenced as "#name". A list picks a random entry each time.
Ticks to blend when switching animations. 0 switches instantly.
